claims.quote: Before release or recovery, recorded receiving evidence must resolve the relevant ancestry and the applicable quality condition. A separate authorized approver is required. A source citation, model answer or narrower proposed hold never releases existing applied holds.

citation_resolution.boundary: Inline references are model output checked against the current isolated indexed original; they are not provider-native citation metadata or approval.

security_change: Require full verbatim original plus exact model-returned document/revision/hash/passage/page against already-verified isolated remote chunks. Legacy keys-only citationless response still rejects.
